svg.title: PPO, DPO, and ORPO trade off model count, reference requirements, and coupling in different ways.
svg.desc: PPO-based RLHF trains an SFT model, a reward model, and then optimizes the policy with reinforcement learning against that reward, an expensive multi-model pipeline. DPO drops the reward model and RL loop, optimizing directly on offline preference pairs against a reference policy. ORPO removes the reference model entirely, combining the SFT loss with an odds-ratio penalty in one coupled training run. None is a default; keep an SFT-only baseline and report both task and preference metrics.
